simple.summary: מִטְפַּחַת (miṭpachath) means a wide cloak (for a woman) First listed occurrence: Isa 3 22.

definitions.full: H4304. mitpachath מִטְמַּ֫חַת noun feminine cloak , absolute עָלַיִךְ אֲשֶׁרֿ הַמִּטְמַּחַת Ruth 3:15 ; plural הַמִּטְמָּחוֺת Isa 3:22 .
